question: The Lohit River is a tributary of which of the following major Himalayan rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Lohit River is a major tributary of the **Brahmaputra River** in the northeastern region of India.
 
• It originates in the eastern Tibet region, from the Zayal Chu (Zayu Chu) river near the Indo-China border, and flows through Arunachal Pradesh before joining the Brahmaputra in Assam.
 
• The Lohit River is known for its swift flow and turbulent waters as it traverses through mountainous terrain.
 
• After entering India, the river flows through the districts of Anjaw and Lohit in Arunachal Pradesh, making the region fertile and supporting agriculture.
 
• The confluence of the Lohit River with the Brahmaputra takes place near the town of Sadia in Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ganga River**

 
 
• The Ganga is the holiest and longest river in India, originating from the Gangotri Glacier in Uttarakhand.
 
• It flows through major Indian states such as Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and West Bengal before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The Ganga has numerous tributaries, including the Yamuna, Ghaghara, Son, and Gandak, but the Lohit River is not one of them.
 
 
 
• **Indus River**
 
 
• The Indus River originates from the Tibetan Plateau near Lake Mansarovar and flows through Ladakh, Pakistan, and finally into the Arabian Sea.
 
• It is one of the longest rivers in Asia and has several tributaries like the Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, and Sutlej.
 
• The Indus River basin does not include the Lohit River.
 
 
 
• **Yamuna River**
 
 
• The Yamuna River is the largest tributary of the Ganga River, originating from the Yamunotri Glacier in Uttarakhand.
 
• It flows through states such as Haryana, Delhi, and Uttar Pradesh before merging with the Ganga at Prayagraj (Allahabad).
 
• The Yamuna does not intersect with the Lohit River.
